title: Nice filter
text: Nice filter. I had no problems with this water filter system.  It works fine. I haven't had the water tested to see if it actually removes the things it says, but it's easy enough to fill and hasn't leaked as of now. Water tastes fine.

product_metadata.title: Brita XL Water Filter Dispenser for Tap and Drinking Water with 1 Standard Filter, Lasts 2 Months, 18-Cup Capacity, BPA Free, Grey
features: The water dispenser is made without BPA and can hold 27 cups of water, enough to fill nine 24-ounce reusable water bottles
description: Drink cleaner, great tasting tap water with this Brita 27 cup UltraMax water dispenser.
